svg.title: OAuth via mcp.absmartly.com
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of the hosted OAuth flow in 15 steps: the MCP client gets a 401 from mcp.absmartly.com, discovers its OAuth metadata, registers by Dynamic Client Registration or a trusted metadata-document client ID, and sends you through the browser to authorize; mcp.absmartly.com then runs a second OAuth flow against your ABsmartly instance, where you sign in, exchanges the code for an ABsmartly session JWT that stays on the server, and finally issues the client its own MCP access and refresh tokens, so MCP calls carry the MCP token while the server calls your instance's API with the session JWT.
svg.text: or client_id is a trusted metadata-document URL (CIMD, no call)
“Connect to ABsmartly”: asks for your instance URL
skipped if approved in this browser in the last 30 days
ABsmartly session JWT (stays on the server)
MCP access token (1 h) + refresh token (30 days)
On refresh, the MCP server re-checks your ABsmartly session via /auth/oauth/userinfo;
if it has ended you sign in again.
